subject: 🧾 Housing payment receipt #$payment_id - £$amount
body:
Dear $student_name,

Thank you. We have received your housing payment. This email is your receipt — please keep it for your records.

=== RECEIPT ===
Receipt / Payment ID: $payment_id
Student ID: $student_id
Payment Type: $payment_type
Amount Paid: £$amount
Payment Method: $payment_method
Payment Date: $payment_date
Status: $status
Transaction Reference: $transaction_reference
Processed By: $processed_by

=== WHAT THIS COVERS ===
Building: $building_name
Room Number: $room_number
Assignment Reference: $assignment_id
$period_line

$finance_account_block

=== RECORDED IN FINANCE ===
This payment has been posted to the university finance system against your student account, so it will appear in your finance statement and on the Housing Payment History screen.
Finance Reference: $finance_reference

=== QUESTIONS ABOUT THIS RECEIPT ===
If anything above is wrong, contact the Housing Office within 14 days quoting the receipt ID.

Housing Office: housing@university.edu
Phone: (555) 123-4567
Office Hours: Monday-Friday, 9:00 AM - 5:00 PM

Best regards,
University Housing Administration

$signature
